body.input: Which health tech companies opened an office in the Netherlands in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available reporting from 2026, the following health tech companies have opened or established offices/operations in the Netherlands during 2026:

1. **Tandem Health** — A Swedish health-tech company (AI-powered clinical documentation platform) opened an office in **Leiden**, hiring for medical operations roles in the Netherlands with a dedicated NL Country Director.

2. **Ahead Health** — A Swiss preventive healthcare company that secured €8.7 million in funding and **launched into Germany and the Netherlands** in 2026 as its first markets outside Switzerland, offering preventive full-body MRI scanning integrated with AI diagnostic screening.

3. **Blue Health Intelligence** — An Amsterdam-based preventive health-tech startup that raised €3.4 million (led by Knop Investments) and established its Amsterdam location, which was reported as fully booked through November 2026. The company plans further European expansion to Paris and Milan in 2027.

These are the companies for which specific 2026 Netherlands office openings or market launches were documented. The Netherlands continues to be an attractive destination for health-tech companies, ranking 3rd globally and 1st in Europe for AI readiness in 2026 according to the IMD World Digital and AI Ranking.

explainability.content: Tandem Health, a Swedish health‑tech company, announced a full‑time role based in Leiden, indicating the company has opened a Netherlands office in 2026.
The job posting describes the role as hybrid and located in Leiden, confirming the physical presence of Tandem Health’s NL office.

Ahead Health secured €8.7 million funding and launched its preventive full‑body MRI screening platform in Germany and the Netherlands, its first markets outside Switzerland, showing a 2026 Netherlands market entry.
The same launch into the Netherlands is reiterated in a separate report, confirming the 2026 expansion into the Dutch market.

Blue Health Intelligence, an Amsterdam‑based preventive health‑tech startup, raised €3.4 million and reported that its Amsterdam location was fully booked through November 2026, indicating an operational office in the Netherlands in 2026.

# Netherlands-Based HealthTech Startup Blue Health Intelligence Raises €3.4M to Expand Preventive Healthcare Services Across Europe

The Knop Investments-led round will support Blue Health Intelligence’s product development and international expansion, with Paris and Milan among its target markets.

3 days ago

Arab Founders

Blue Health Intelligence, an Amsterdam-based preventive HealthTech startup, has raised €3.4 million in funding to expand its healthcare services across Europe and accelerate the development of its digital health platform. [...] He pointed to the company’s booking figures and demand at its Amsterdam location as indicators of customer interest in preventive healthcare services.

The investment will provide the founding team with additional resources to develop its products and enter new European markets.

Blue Health Intelligence was co-founded by Huyghe, who previously served as Chief Commercial Officer at Swapfiets and Tibber, and Verdonck, a physician and healthcare entrepreneur.

Their backgrounds combine commercial experience with medical expertise as the startup develops its preventive healthcare business.

## Targeting Paris and Milan in 2027

With €3.4 million in new funding, Blue Health Intelligence will focus on expanding its service offering and preparing for its first international launch. [...] The company has also established partnerships with TrainMore, Hotel & Wellness Zuiver and Fosbury & Sons Amsterdam.

These partnerships form part of its efforts to reach customers through fitness, wellness and workplace-related environments.

According to Knop Investments, the Amsterdam location was fully booked through November at the time of the funding announcement.

The reported demand has supported the company’s plans to expand its physical presence while continuing to develop its technology platform.

## Knop Investments Backs Preventive Healthcare Model

Maurits Koning, Managing Director at Knop Investments, said Blue Health Intelligence has demonstrated growing demand for accessible information about personal health.

### The Netherlands is a competitive environment for AI innovation and growth

The Netherlands’ leading position reflects its strong foundations for digital transformation. With advanced digital infrastructure, a highly skilled workforce and a collaborative innovation ecosystem, the country provides an attractive environment for international companies developing and applying AI technologies.

Through close cooperation between businesses, research institutions and government, the Netherlands IT & Tech ecosystem offers opportunities to develop, test and scale AI solutions across sectors, from high tech and life sciences to agrifood and logistics.

### A leading European location for digital innovation [...] ### A leading European location for digital innovation

As AI increasingly shapes global business and investment decisions, the Netherlands’ position in the IMD ranking underlines its attractiveness as a European location for technology driven companies.

By combining digital capabilities with responsible governance and a connected innovation ecosystem, the Netherlands provides a strong foundation for international companies looking to expand their European activities, accelerate innovation and build for the future.

Source: IMD World Digital and AI Ranking 2026
